How many feature columns are there, excluding the class/label column?
What is the name of the label/target column?
Are the feature columns (f1...f617) numeric or categorical?
How many samples belong to class 6?
Which class has the fewest samples, and how many?
Is the dataset perfectly class-balanced (same number of rows per class)?
What is the standard deviation of column f1?
What is the mean value of column f10?
What are the min and max values of column f100?
What are the min and max values of column f10?
What are the min and max values of column f617?
How many rows have a value of f1 greater than 0?
What is the Pearson correlation coefficient between f1 and f2?
What is the average value of f300 for rows in class 20?

notes.problem: The CSV eval could not run end to end.
notes.root_cause: The eval generator had no tools registered, the schema prompt printed all 617 columns (~40k tokens), Call 2 still allowed tool calls, and the scorer could not compare (min, max) answers.
notes.fix: Registered the pandas sandbox tool in the eval, cut the schema to 20 detailed columns plus a summary, rebuilt Call 2 without tools, added range scoring.
notes.result: First working run on 15 questions. Still open: schema_02 fails because the label column is hidden by the schema cutoff.

config.schema_serialization: to_prompt_string() with THRESHOLD=20 truncation + dtype-grouped summary for remaining columns (known gap: doesn't guarantee label/target column visibility)
config.tool_registration: generator.tools set explicitly in eval script to match production's per-request mutation
config.synthesis_call: fresh system+user messages, no tools/tool_choice passed, explicit no-further-computation instruction
config.scoring: deterministic numeric/range/string match (via compute_golden_value using golden_pandas_code) with LLM-judge fallback for categorical/fuzzy answers
